evidence_status: executed notebook outputs; not independently rerun in this repository checkout

primary_dataset.template: When {first} and {second} went to the {place}, {subject} gave a {object} to

held_out_template.template: After {first} and {second} arrived at the {place}, {subject} handed a {object} to

held_out_lexicon.template: same syntactic template as D0; disjoint notebook lexical lists

metric: Mean correct-indirect-object logit minus subject-name logit. Patching score is the fraction of the clean-to-corrupted mean gap removed by replacing a component activation with its corrupted activation.
known_evidence_limitations: Raw activations, per-example intervention values, generated CSV files, and result tensors are absent from this checkout.
The notebook contains inconsistent prose summaries. The numerical record used in results/executed_notebook_evidence.json is taken from its printed execution outputs.
No factorial head-by-MLP intervention was executed, so this repository does not support a causal claim about head-MLP interaction.
